messages:
harper_mktg: Quick sync 24h before publish4 need final canary window, canonical docs link, and HubSpot form for webinar. Target publish: 2026-03-28 15:00 PT.

devin_eng: Proposed rollout: 20m smoke -> 90m canary -> phased ramp. Canary start 2026-03-28T03:00:00Z. End conditions: rollback if errors >1.8% for 10m or median latency +28%.

sora_docs: Docs preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-28. Changelog draft ready; will add note about model-pinning being opt-in via config flag. Canonical will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-28 after merge.

nate_product: Merge docs first if possible. Add one-liner for Dedicated customers to contact CS for assisted rollouts.

iris_sales: HubSpot form: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/spring-announce-28. Tags: ["spring-announce-2026","bench-signup"]. Please ensure webinar registrants get the "bench-signup" tag if they come from the benchmark post.

harper_mktg: Copy for announce: "Rolling out faster inference: cache warmups, optional model pinning, and smarter batching. See changelog and docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-28. Join our webinar Thurs 11:00 PT for demos + Q&A." Need bench PNG (median latency graph) and final docs URL to lock social.

devin_eng: Perf team will export the bench PNG and attach here by 2026-03-27 18:00 PT. Canary endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat-stream. Throttle canary to 12rps, ramp to 48rps on success.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: smoke 2026-03-28T02:40:00Z; canary 2026-03-28T03:00:00Z -> 2026-03-28T04:30:00Z; ramp 2026-03-28T05:00:00Z. Rollback thresholds as stated.

harper_mktg: Final checklist: 1) canonical docs URL (sora), 2) canary endpoints + thresholds (devin), 3) HubSpot + tags (iris), 4) bench PNG (devin). If all green we'll schedule publish for Mon 15:00 PT. Ping @marketing-alert if anything slips.

sora_docs: Will merge preview after final proof at 2026-03-27 21:00 PT and post canonical link here.

devin_eng: Bench PNG ETA 18:00 PT tomorrow. All tests passing in staging.

harper_mktg: Great 1ock and thanks everyone! :tada:
